steps.fact: The left referent is billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.
Billing records bill the name Northbridge Analytics Inc.
Registry row 2019-0008841 names NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS LLC (Wyoming, active).
Commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct to treat the registry link as unresolved.
No packet evidence establishes that Northbridge Analytics Inc. is the same legal entity as registry 2019-0008841; name similarity and related naming variants are insufficient for identity.
No packet evidence establishes that billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and registry:2019-0008841 are distinct legal entities.

support_claim: The packet records billing under Northbridge Analytics Inc. and registry 2019-0008841 as Northbridge Analytics LLC, but explicitly states legal has not determined the contracting registry entity and that the registry link should be treated as unresolved.
